title: POWERFUL SUNDAY MORNING FIRE PRAYERS TO DESTROY EVILS TODAY
text: Listen. Listen to me. Right now, in this very moment, the spirit of God is breaking the assignment of heaviness that was scheduled against your morning. Do you understand what I'm saying? There is a spirit, a demonic assignment that wakes up with you. It comes on your shoulders before your feet touch the ground. It speaks lies to your consciousness. It tells you that today will be hard. That today will be a struggle. That you cannot do what God has called you to do. >> [music] >> But I tell you this morning, that assignment is broken. Before you even prayed, before you [music] even asked, before you even realize what was happening in the spirit realm, the blood of Jesus has already shattered the attack of heaviness meant for your day. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. >> [music] >> Let me pray. Father God, in the name of Jesus Christ, I stand in the office of an apostle, and I come against every spirit of heaviness, every spirit of depression, every spirit of darkness, every oppressive force that has been assigned to the morning season of the people of God, I bind you. I paralyze you. I render you powerless over the lives that belong to the almighty. Every alarm [music] clock that was set in the spirit realm to trigger depression, I dismantle it. Every assignment from the second heaven meant to steal joy from this morning, I break it. Every witchcraft pronouncement that says this day will be hard, [music] I reverse it by the power of the blood of Jesus. I speak to your consciousness. I speak to your mental landscape. I speak to your emotions. I speak [music] to every thought pattern that heaviness has tried to establish. Freedom comes now. Clarity comes now. Joy comes now. Someone needs to hear this. You woke up this morning and you could not explain the weight on your chest. You could not understand why your spirit felt pressed down. You could not identify why immediately upon waking a cloud came over your mind. I declare [music] that weight is not from God. That oppression is not your portion. That heaviness is not your inheritance. You are a child of the most high God. You carry the DNA of heaven. You are seated in heavenly places. You are crowned with favor. And no spirit of darkness has the right to wrap itself around your morning. Thus said the spirit of God to someone watching this. The fog you felt when you woke up was demonic. The confusion you experienced was calculated. The heaviness on your heart was a scheduled attack. But I declare right now it is broken. It is scattered. >> [music] >> It is defeated. The victory of Jesus Christ annihilates that darkness. Listen carefully. There are dimensions to the spirit of heaviness that most believers do not understand. When you go to bed at night, you think you're just going to sleep. But in the spirit realm, you are entering a season of vulnerability. Your spirit man is [music] in a different state of consciousness. And there are forces, demonic forces that work specifically in those hours to program your morning. They speak curses over you in the night season. They plant thoughts in your subconscious. They establish patterns of defeat. They rehearse failure in your dreams. They show you images of limitation. And when you wake up, you wake up burdened by what was spoken in the invisible realm. Ephesians 6:12 says this, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Do you hear me? Your struggle is not against a person. Your struggle is not against your circumstances. Your struggle is spiritual. [music] And if you're are to win, you must fight spiritually. The spirit of heaviness is a ruler of darkness. It is a principality. It is an organized force of the enemy kingdom. And it has been [music] specifically assigned to your morning season to steal your anointing, to diminish your authority, to weaken your faith, to reduce your effectiveness for the kingdom of God. But I'm telling you this morning that assignment ends now. >> [music] >> I want you to understand something. In the Old Testament, there is a beautiful passage, Isaiah 61:1-3. Listen to what the spirit of the Lord says. The spirit of the Lord God is upon me [music] because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings onto [music] the meek. He hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound, >> [music] >> to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all that mourn, to appoint onto them that mourn in Zion, to give onto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. Do you hear what I'm saying? The Bible identifies the spirit of heaviness. It names it. It calls it out. And it says that the anointing of God is specifically designed to replace heaviness [music] with praise, to exchange mourning for joy, to transform ashes into beauty. This is your morning inheritance. This is what Jesus died to secure [music] for you. This is what the blood of Calvary purchased. When Jesus went to the cross, when he shed his blood, when he rose on the third day, he didn't just save your soul. He broke the power of every demonic assignment that would try to steal your joy, your peace, your authority, your anointing. And I tell you this morning, if you are feeling heaviness, if you are experiencing oppression, if you are walking under a cloud, that is not your portion. That is an attack. That is an assignment, and it is time to break it. Listen, I'm not speaking to you in theory. I'm not giving you nice words. I'm speaking to you as a man who works in the apostolic office. I'm speaking to you with the authority of Jesus Christ. I'm speaking to you because the spirit of God has given me the mandate to unlock the blessings that have been delayed for you. Someone under the sound of my voice, you have been walking heavy for weeks. Weeks of unexplained sadness. Weeks of a weight you cannot shake. Weeks of feeling like you're pushing uphill in every area of your life. The Lord says to you this morning, that ends now. The spirit of God is coming to lift that heaviness off your life. The spirit of God is coming to break the cycle. The spirit of God is coming to restore the joy of your salvation. There is a woman The Lord shows me a woman who has been waking up at 3:00 in the morning. You wake up and your mind immediately goes to worry. Immediately goes to anxiety. Immediately goes to what could go wrong. You lie there for an hour or more and you cannot get back to sleep because heaviness has possessed your thought life. The Lord says to you, that spirit is broken. I command sleep to return. I command your mind to be at peace. I command the heaviness to depart from your consciousness by the power of the blood of Jesus. Rest comes to your night and clarity comes to your mornings. There is a man The Lord shows me a man who has been experiencing heaviness in his spirit concerning his marriage. You wake up and instead of joy about your wife, there is a weight. Instead of anticipation, there is dread. Instead of faith, there is heaviness. The Lord says to you this morning, that is a lie. That heaviness does not belong in your heart. >> [music] >> I break every spirit of division that is trying to make your marriage feel heavy. I break [music] every demonic whisper that is trying to make you doubt your wife's love. I break every assignment of marital heaviness. Your marriage is shifting. Your love is [music] awakening. The joy of your union is restored. Now, listen. I want you to understand the source of morning heaviness. When you wake up without praying, [music] when you wake up without declaring the authority of Christ, when you wake up without speaking to the spirit realm, the demonic realm immediately moves to fill that void. They have assignments waiting. They have causes ready. They have heaviness preloaded, and they immediately begin to press it upon your consciousness. But when you wake up in prayer, when you wake up in declaration, when you wake up in the authority of Jesus Christ, when you speak to the spirit realm, and you command your day to be one of joy, peace, and power, something shifts. The heaviness cannot land. [music] The oppression cannot take root. The darkness cannot establish itself. >> [music] >> This is why morning is critical. This is why the first moments after you wake up are warfare moments. This is why you cannot afford to scroll on your phone. You cannot afford to check the news. You cannot afford to engage with the natural realm before you have first engaged with the spiritual realm. You must pray. You must declare. You must speak your authority. You must command your day. You must break [music] the attacks that are scheduled against you. Psalms 5:3 says, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." [music] David understood this. David knew that the morning was a critical season. David knew that if he did not speak to God in the morning, [music] if he did not direct his prayer toward heaven in the morning, his day would be vulnerable to the attacks of the enemy. You are the lineage of David. You carry the spirit of a warrior. You carry the authority of heaven. And I'm telling you this morning, it is time to take your position. Now, let me pray something specific over this heaviness. Because I feel the spirit of God moving. I feel the weight of the Lord pressing on my spirit. And I know that someone needs this breakthrough in this moment. Father God, I come before you in the name of Jesus Christ. And I take authority over every spirit of heaviness that has been assigned to this morning season. I break the assignments. I paralyze the assignments. I render them null and void by the blood of the blood of Jesus. I speak to the spirit of depression, depart. I speak to the spirit of anxiety, depart. I speak to the spirit of dread, depart. >> [music] >> I speak to every oppressive force, depart from these lives. I command every demonic [music] assignment that was scheduled to trigger heaviness upon waking to be completely dismantled. I speak to the second heaven. I speak [music] to the kingdom of darkness. I declare that Jesus is Lord. And under his authority, I command the spirit of heaviness to release the people of God. Every thought pattern that heaviness has tried to establish, I break it. Every neural pathway that has been programmed toward depression and despair, I reprogram [music] it with the joy of the Lord. Every emotion that has been hijacked by darkness, I reclaim it for peace. I speak to your consciousness. Your consciousness [music] belongs to Jesus Christ. I speak to your mind. Your mind belongs to Jesus Christ. I speak to your emotions. Your emotions belong to Jesus Christ and I break [music] every demonic claim upon what God has redeemed. Now, listen. Someone needs to know the heaviness that you have been feeling is not just emotional, it is not just psychological, it is spiritual. [music] There is a demon, there is an assignment. There is a [music] coordinated attack and you have been experiencing the symptoms of that spiritual reality, but the power of God is greater. The authority of Jesus is supreme. The blood of Jesus is sufficient. And in the authority of his name, I break that [music] attack. Someone is hearing this and tears are coming to your eyes. The spirit of God is touching your heart. You have been ever so heavy. You have carried this weight for so [music] long and right now in this moment, something is shifting in your spirit. Something is changing. The heaviness is lifting. Let me tell you what you're feeling. >> [music] >> That is the spirit of God. That is the presence of God. That is the power of God touching you and breaking that demonic assignment. Do not deny it. Do not suppress it. Let it flow. Let the Lord minister to your spirit. Shalalala. Malekum shalom. Jehovah maley shalom. Jehovah Jehovah maley. Jehovah maley. Shalalala Jehovah Adonai. The spirit of God is moving right now. The atmosphere is shifting. The assignments of heaviness are being broken. The captives are being set free. Let me go deeper. Because there is something the spirit of the Lord is revealing. The spirit of heaviness does not work alone. It works with other demonic principalities. It works in coordination with other forces of darkness. When heaviness comes, it often comes with the spirit of rejection. It comes with the spirit of inadequacy. It comes with the spirit of fear. It comes with the spirit of discouragement. These are coordinated attacks. These are demonic teams working together to overwhelm you. The spirit of rejection says, "Nobody values you. Nobody sees you. You don't matter." And heaviness says, "So why even try? So why even get out of bed? So why even pursue your destiny?" The spirit of inadequacy says you're not good enough. You're not smart enough. You're not anointed enough." And heaviness says, "So accept your limitations. Accept your failure. Accept that you will never be who God called you to be." The spirit of fear says, "What if it goes wrong? What if you fail? What if you are exposed?" And heaviness says, "So don't move. So don't take the step. So don't pursue the promise." But I'm telling you this morning, these coordinated attacks are being shattered. I break the spirit of rejection from your life. I declare that you are valued. You [music] are seen. You do matter. God knew you before the foundation of the world. God called you by your name. God has plans for you that will prosper you and not harm you. I break the spirit of inadequacy from your life. I declare that you are enough. You are equipped. You are anointed. The Holy Ghost lives inside of you. The power of God dwells within your spirit. You have everything you need to accomplish the will of God in your generation. I break [music] the spirit of fear from your life. I declare that God has not given you a spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind. [music] You are a warrior. You are a conqueror. You are more than a conqueror through him that loved you. And I break the spirit of heaviness that has been working with these other principalities. Heaviness, your assignment is over. Your time is finished. Your power [music] is broken. Now, let me let me speak something into the atmosphere because the spirit of God is moving and I'm sensing something specific. There are dimensions to your morning that you do not understand. In the spirit realm, your morning is a battleground. It is where the enemy makes his greatest push. It is where demonic forces are most aggressive. It is where the forces of darkness are most coordinated. Why? Because your morning determines your day. Because your morning sets the tone. Because your morning establishes your faith. Because your morning activates or deactivates your anointing. If you start your morning in heaviness, you will carry that heaviness throughout your day. If you start your morning in defeat, you will experience defeat throughout your day. If you start your morning separated from God, you will walk separated from God throughout your day. But, if you start your morning in prayer, you will be powerful throughout your day. If you start your morning in declaration, you will be victorious throughout your day. If you start your morning in faith, [music] you will overcome throughout your day. This is why the enemy fights so hard for your morning. This is why the spirit of heaviness is specifically assigned to your morning season. The enemy knows that if he can capture your morning, he can diminish your day. But, you are not ignorant of the enemy's [music] devices. You are not walking in darkness. You understand the battle. And you are armed with the weapons of God. [music] 2 Corinthians 10: 3 and 4 say, "For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh. For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. Your weapons are spiritual. Your authority is spiritual. Your power is spiritual. And the stronghold of heaviness, that is a spiritual stronghold, must be pulled down with spiritual weapons. What are those weapons? Prayer, declaration, the blood of Jesus, the name of Jesus, the word of God, the authority of Christ. When you wake up tomorrow morning and heaviness tries to come, you declare, "I break the spirit of heaviness [music] in the name of Jesus." When depression tries to settle on your consciousness, you command, "I command depression to depart by the power of the blood of Jesus." >> [music] >> When dread tries to grip your heart, you speak, "I speak joy, peace, and power over my day in the authority of Jesus Christ." This is how you win. This is how you overcome. This is how you break the assignment. Listen, there is something else I'm sensing from the spirit of God, and I want to address this because I know that some of you have been blaming yourselves for the heaviness. You think it's your fault. You think you're not praying enough. You think you're not believing enough. You think you're not spiritual enough. No. I'm breaking that lie right now. The heaviness you have been experiencing is [music] not your fault. It is an attack. It is a demonic assignment. It is an organized force of darkness that has been strategically deployed against you. Now, I'm not saying that your own thinking patterns have not contributed. I'm not saying that your own agreements with heaviness have not strengthened the assignment, [music] but the root cause is spiritual. The source of the heaviness is demonic, and you cannot blame yourself for an assignment [music] that was sent against you without your consent. Someone needs to hear this because you have been carrying guilt. You have been carrying shame. You have been carrying self-condemnation because you have been living under a heaviness [music] that you could not explain, and you thought this must be me. This must be my fault. I must not be spiritual enough to overcome this. [music] I'm telling you this morning that is a lie from the pit of hell. You are not at fault. You are a victim [music] of an attack, but you are not a helpless victim. You are an empowered victim. You have the authority of Jesus Christ. You have the blood of Jesus. You have the Holy Ghost, and you can break this assignment. So, right now, I want you to forgive yourself. I want you to release the guilt. I want you to release the shame. I want you to release the self-condemnation. You did not fail. You are not weak. You are not inadequate. You have been under attack. And now you are arming yourself to win. Shalalala Jehovah. Shalalala Adonai Malachi. Jehovah Malachi Shalom. Shalalala Malachi. The spirit of God is speaking. >> [music] >> The spirit of God is moving. The spirit of God is breaking the assignments. Now, let me address the financial dimension of this heaviness. Because the spirit of heaviness often comes with a financial component. It comes with the weight of financial pressure. It comes with the burden of financial limitation. It comes with the oppression of financial bondage. Someone wakes up and they think about their bills. They think about their debts. They think about their lack. And heaviness immediately wraps around their heart. And they go through their day with financial heaviness pressing down on them. But I'm telling you the spirit of heaviness that is attached to your finances is being broken. Proverbs 10:22 says, "The blessing of the Lord it maketh rich, and he added no sorrow thereto." This is powerful. This means that true blessing does not come with heaviness. Real prosperity does not come with oppression. Authentic abundance does not come with pressure. If you are experiencing financial heaviness, that is not the blessing of God. That is an attack of the enemy. That is a demonic assignment designed to create fear, to create limitation, to create hopelessness about your financial future. But, I break that assignment right now. I speak to the financial gates of your life. >> [music] >> I speak to the provision that God has destined for you. I declare that the heaviness that has been attached to your finances is broken. I declare that you are moving into a season of financial joy. I declare that you will experience provision without oppression. I declare that abundance is flowing toward you. >> [music] >> Someone under the sound of my voice, a woman named Grace, the Lord says to you that the heaviness you have felt about your finances is about to lift. [music] You have been carrying the weight of providing for your family. You have been carrying the burden of making [music] ends meet. But, the Lord says your season is changing. Provision is shifting. You are moving into a season where your resources exceed your needs, where your abundance overflows. Where financial heaviness is replaced with financial joy. There is a man named Samuel. The Lord says to you that the financial embargo that has been on your business is breaking. The heaviness that comes every [music] time you look at your accounts that is being lifted. I decree and declare that your business is moving into a season of acceleration. Your profits are increasing. Your market is expanding. The spirit of heaviness that has shadowed your finances is departing. There is a young woman named Zainab. The Lord shows me that you have been feeling heaviness about your future earnings. You have been uncertain about whether you will be able to provide for yourself and your family. But, the Lord says that heaviness is a lie. You have a calling. You have an anointing. You have gifts that will cause you to prosper. And in this season, those gifts are being activated. Your earning capacity is expanding. Your financial future is secure. Now, let me speak to the health dimension of this heaviness because there is often a physical heaviness that accompany spiritual heaviness. >> [music] >> There is a heaviness in your body. There is a weight in your limbs. There is a fatigue that goes beyond natural tiredness. [music] Someone wakes up and you feel exhausted even though you slept 8 hours. Someone wakes up and your body feels heavy. Someone wakes up and you feel weak and you cannot explain why. That physical heaviness is connected to the spiritual heaviness. When a demon brings heaviness into your spirit, it manifests in your physical body as fatigue, as weakness, as heaviness, but I break that assignment. I speak to your body. I declare that it is strong. I speak to your energy levels. I declare that they are restored. I speak to your physical vitality. I declare that it is renewed. Someone here, James, the Lord shows me that you have been experiencing heaviness and fatigue in your body. The Lord says to you that the spirit that has been pressing [music] down on your body, making you feel old before your time, making you feel weak and tired, that spirit is being cast out. Your youth is being restored. Your vitality is being activated. You will walk in the strength [music] and power that God has given you. Now listen, I want to address something that is very important because the spirit of heaviness is often connected to unforgiveness. [music] When you hold unforgiveness in your heart, you create a legal ground for the spirit of heaviness to operate in your life. Unforgiveness is heavy. It is a burden. [music] It is a weight. It is an oppression. When you refuse to forgive, you are agreeing with the enemy. You are giving the enemy legal right to bring heaviness into your life. Matthew 11:28-30 says, "Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn of me, for I am meek and lowly in heart, and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light." The yoke of Jesus is light. The burden of Jesus is easy, but when you hold unforgiveness, you are no longer under the yoke of Jesus. You are under the yoke of bitterness. You are under the burden of resentment. And that burden is heavy. So, I'm telling you this morning, if you have been living with heaviness, forgive, release, let go. Forgive the person who hurt you. Forgive the person who disappointed you. Forgive the person who betrayed you. Forgive the person who rejected you. Forgive them. Not because they deserve it. Not because what they did was right. But because you deserve to be free. You deserve to be light. You deserve to experience the easy yoke of Jesus. And when you forgive, the heaviness lifts. The oppression breaks. The weight release. Someone needs to know there is a person. Someone has deeply hurt you. You have held on to that hurt for years. And that unforgiveness has been heavy. But the Lord is saying to you this morning, release it. Forgive them. And as you [music] forgive them, as you release that weight, you will experience a lightness in your spirit that you have not felt in a long time. Your heaviness will be gone.
